data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error in the qwen report (HTTP 400 BadRequestError when auditing .SRCINFO), which caused it to return inconclusive. The deepseek report successfully audited all files and found them safe. The openrouter/free report is advisory-only and doesn't count toward the verdict. There is no actual security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen report failed to audit .SRCINFO due to API error (HTTP 400), resulting in inconclusive verdict
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should trigger automatic retry or fallback to alternative models to prevent inconclusive verdicts
When one model fails due to tool error, the audit system should recognize this as a coverage gap rather than a security disagreement
Standard -bin packages with pinned checksums from official upstream sources are low-risk and should be processed efficiently
